input: Donate unused kitchen appliances to a charity shop

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which specific appliances are in scope determines the volume, effort to prepare them, and whether any need special handling (e.g. large vs small items).
Whether the user will drop off items or needs a collection arranged completely changes the immediate next actions and timeline.
The user's location affects which charity shops are nearby and accessible, directly determining where to donate.
A target date or deadline shapes how urgently the task needs to be broken down and whether booking a van or collection is required.
If the user has a specific charity or cause they care about, that narrows which shops to target rather than the nearest generic option.
Some appliances may need cleaning, testing, or having cables secured before donation — knowing the user's prep expectations affects the task steps.
Understanding what 'done' looks like — e.g. items physically dropped off vs. a confirmed receipt from the charity — defines the final step of the plan.

gold.taskTitle: Donate unused kitchen appliances to a charity shop
gold.taskDescription: Sort through unused kitchen appliances and get them donated to a suitable charity shop.

questions.title: Which specific appliances are you donating?
questions.description: Identify the exact items in scope — e.g. toaster, blender, air fryer — to determine volume and any special handling needed.

questions.title: Will you drop off, or do you need a collection?
questions.description: Establish whether the user will transport items themselves or needs to arrange a charity collection service, as this changes all logistics steps.

questions.title: What area or town are you based in?
questions.description: Location determines which charity shops are realistically reachable and whether collection services operate nearby.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline for clearing these items?
questions.description: A target date or urgency level affects how the task is sequenced and whether time-sensitive bookings need to be made.

questions.title: Is there a particular charity or cause you prefer?
questions.description: A preferred charity (e.g. hospice, homelessness, animals) narrows the search to specific shops rather than the nearest available option.

questions.title: Do the appliances need cleaning or testing first?
questions.description: Understanding the expected prep standard — wiped down, tested working, original box included — determines the preparation steps in the plan.

questions.title: What does 'done' look like to you for this task?
questions.description: Clarify whether success means items are out of the house, physically handed over, or a receipt/confirmation is received from the charity.
